title: KGContext
description: KG subgraph extracted around the target event asset. Output of Step 5B. Defines the structural search space for causal candidate generation.

subgraph_id.description: Stable ID for this subgraph snapshot — referenced by evidence_bundle retrieval_scope and causality_candidates.

kg_snapshot_version.description: Version or timestamp of the KG at query time. Required for reproducibility — RCA must be replayable against the KG state that existed at event time.

hop_limit.description: Maximum hops used to expand the neighborhood. Configurable per system type.

components.description: Component nodes in the subgraph realized by the event asset and its neighbors.

relation_to_asset.description: Topological relationship of this component to the event asset.

seed_match_type.description: Development/runtime provenance for why this component was included (e.g., seed, telemetry).

hop_distance.description: Graph hop distance from the event asset.

edge_types_traversed.description: KG edge types traversed to reach this component.

upstream_paths.description: Explicit upstream causal paths from neighbor components to the event asset.

nodes.description: Ordered list of KG node IDs from upstream cause to event asset.

edge_attributes.description: Edge-level temporal or capacity attributes (e.g., install_date, flow_capacity).

downstream_paths.description: Downstream propagation paths — components that could be affected by or have been affected by the event. Mirrors upstream_paths structure.

failure_modes.description: FMEA failure mode nodes mapped to components in the subgraph.

fm_id.description: Canonical failure mode ID in the KG.

failure_mechanism.description: Physical mechanism (e.g., fatigue, corrosion, wear, overload).

expected_symptoms.description: Expected symptom types for this failure mode — matched against event.json symptom_signature.symptom_types.

expected_anomaly_pattern.description: Expected telemetry pattern — matched against telemetry_summary anomaly patterns.

expected_latency_min_days.description: Minimum expected failure progression time from FMEA.

fmea_source_ref.description: Source FMEA document or node reference.

rpn.description: Risk Priority Number from FMEA, if available.

documents_in_neighborhood.description: CR/WO/SOP/ECA document nodes linked to components in the subgraph. Defines the valid document scope for evidence_bundle retrieval.

link_type.description: KG edge type connecting document to component (e.g., DESCRIBES, CORRECTS, GOVERNS).

documents.description: Runtime alias for documents_in_neighborhood used by the current orchestrator.

past_events.description: Prior abnormal_event nodes in the KG on the same asset or subgraph components.

fm_id.description: Failure mode linked to this past event, if established.

seed_context.description: Runtime seeding/provenance used by the current orchestrator during development.
